import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- Disjoint-set structure stored as an explicit component-label array.
`find` is a pure array lookup, `union` relabels one whole class. -/
structure DSU where
  lbl : Array Nat

def DSU.init (n : Nat) : DSU := ⟨Array.ofFn (n := n) (fun i : Fin n => (i : Nat))⟩

def DSU.find (d : DSU) (x : Nat) : Nat := d.lbl.getD x x

def DSU.union (d : DSU) (x y : Nat) : DSU :=
  if d.find x = d.find y then d
  else ⟨d.lbl.map (fun l => if l = d.find y then d.find x else l)⟩

/-- All stored (directed) adjacency entries, as `MSTEdge`s. -/
def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap (fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).map (fun p => (⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩ : MSTEdge)))

def sortedEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (allEdges g).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))

/-- One greedy step: keep the edge iff its endpoints are in different components. -/
def kruskalStep (st : DSU × List MSTEdge) (e : MSTEdge) : DSU × List MSTEdge :=
  if st.1.find e.u = st.1.find e.v then st
  else (st.1.union e.u e.v, e :: st.2)

def kruskalCore (g : WeightedGraph) : DSU × List MSTEdge :=
  (sortedEdges g).foldl kruskalStep (DSU.init g.size, [])

/-- Reachability through an edge list, i.e. the body of `is_connected_with_edges`. -/
def Reach (es : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges es p

/-- One undirected hop along the edge list. -/
def Step (es : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop := edges_contain es u v

/-- Reflexive-transitive closure form of reachability: this is the working notion,
`Reach` is the shape the specification demands. -/
def Reach' (es : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop := Relation.ReflTransGen (Step es) u v

/-- Component-label invariant for the disjoint-set structure. -/
def DSU.Inv (d : DSU) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  d.lbl.size = n ∧ ∀ i, i < n → d.find i < n ∧ d.find (d.find i) = d.find i

/-- Unconditional union of one edge (the `kruskalStep` DSU component, unfiltered). -/
def uni (d : DSU) (e : MSTEdge) : DSU := d.union e.u e.v

def foldU (d : DSU) (es : List MSTEdge) : DSU := es.foldl uni d

/-- Number of components: distinct labels among the `n` nodes. -/
def comp (d : DSU) (n : Nat) : Nat := ((Finset.range n).image d.find).card

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kruskal_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (kruskalCore graph).2.reverse
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

-- Layer 0: weight plumbing.

theorem foldl_w (es : List MSTEdge) (a : Int) :
    es.foldl (fun sum e => sum + e.w) a = a + (es.map MSTEdge.w).sum := by
  induction es generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons e t ih => simp [ih, add_assoc]

theorem total_weight_eq_sum (es : List MSTEdge) :
    total_weight es = (es.map MSTEdge.w).sum := by
  simp [total_weight, foldl_w]

theorem total_weight_perm {es₁ es₂ : List MSTEdge} (h : es₁.Perm es₂) :
    total_weight es₁ = total_weight es₂ := by
  rw [total_weight_eq_sum, total_weight_eq_sum]
  exact (h.map MSTEdge.w).sum_eq

-- Layer 0: the edge pool is exactly the set of valid edges.

theorem mem_allEdges_iff (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) :
    e ∈ allEdges g ↔ e.is_valid g := by
  obtain ⟨eu, ev, ew⟩ := e
  simp only [allEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range,
    MSTEdge.is_valid, WeightedGraph.has_edge, MSTEdge.mk.injEq, Array.mem_toList_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, p, hp, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hu, p, hp, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, p, hp, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨eu, hu, p, hp, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem sortedEdges_perm (g : WeightedGraph) : (sortedEdges g).Perm (allEdges g) :=
  List.mergeSort_perm _ _

-- Layer 2: `Reach` plumbing.

theorem Reach.refl (es : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : Reach es u u :=
  ⟨[u], rfl, rfl, by simp, by intro i hi; simp at hi⟩

theorem Reach.of_edge {es : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} (he : e ∈ es) :
    Reach es e.u e.v := by
  refine ⟨[e.u, e.v], rfl, rfl, by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have : i = 0 := by simp at hi; omega
  subst this
  exact ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

theorem Reach.mono {es₁ es₂ : List MSTEdge} (hsub : es₁ ⊆ es₂) {u v : Nat}
    (h : Reach es₁ u v) : Reach es₂ u v := by
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, hlen, hstep⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p, h1, h2, hlen, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨e, he, hend⟩ := hstep i hi
  exact ⟨e, hsub he, hend⟩

theorem Step.symm {es : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Step es u v) : Step es v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hor⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, hor.symm⟩

theorem Reach'.symm {es : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Reach' es u v) : Reach' es v u :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.symmetric (fun _ _ => Step.symm) h

theorem Reach'.mono {es₁ es₂ : List MSTEdge} (hsub : es₁ ⊆ es₂) {u v : Nat}
    (h : Reach' es₁ u v) : Reach' es₂ u v := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hbc ih =>
      obtain ⟨e, he, hor⟩ := hbc
      exact ih.tail ⟨e, hsub he, hor⟩

-- Layer 1: disjoint-set structure.

theorem DSU.find_eq_getElem {d : DSU} {a : Nat} (ha : a < d.lbl.size) :
    d.find a = d.lbl[a] := by
  simp [DSU.find, Array.getD, ha]

theorem DSU.union_size (d : DSU) (x y : Nat) : (d.union x y).lbl.size = d.lbl.size := by
  unfold DSU.union
  split <;> simp

/-- Closed form: `union x y` relabels exactly the class of `y` to the label of `x`. -/
theorem DSU.find_union {d : DSU} {x y a : Nat} (ha : a < d.lbl.size) :
    (d.union x y).find a = if d.find a = d.find y then d.find x else d.find a := by
  unfold DSU.union
  split
  · rename_i h
    rw [h]
    split
    · assumption
    · rfl
  · simp only [DSU.find] at *
    simp [Array.getD, ha]

/-- Equivalence classes after `union x y`: the classes of `x` and `y` are joined. -/
theorem DSU.find_union_iff {d : DSU} {x y a b : Nat}
    (ha : a < d.lbl.size) (hb : b < d.lbl.size) :
    ((d.union x y).find a = (d.union x y).find b) ↔
      (d.find a = d.find b ∨ (d.find a = d.find x ∧ d.find b = d.find y)
        ∨ (d.find a = d.find y ∧ d.find b = d.find x)) := by
  by_cases hxy : d.find x = d.find y
  · unfold DSU.union
    rw [if_pos hxy]
    constructor
    · exact Or.inl
    · rintro (h | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
      · exact h
      · rw [h1, h2, hxy]
      · rw [h1, h2, hxy]
  · rw [DSU.find_union ha, DSU.find_union hb]
    split_ifs with hA hB hB <;> simp_all [eq_comm] <;> tauto

/-- The disjoint-set labels track exactly reachability in the accepted edge list. -/
def DSU.Tracks (d : DSU) (n : Nat) (acc : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  d.lbl.size = n ∧ ∀ a b, a < n → b < n → (d.find a = d.find b ↔ Reach' acc a b)

theorem Reach'_nil {a b : Nat} : Reach' [] a b ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => rfl
    | tail _ hbc _ => obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := hbc; simp at he
  · rintro rfl; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

theorem Reach'.single {es : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} (he : e ∈ es) :
    Reach' es e.u e.v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Adding one edge joins exactly the two components it touches. -/
theorem Reach'_cons_iff {acc : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} :
    Reach' (e :: acc) a b ↔
      (Reach' acc a b ∨ (Reach' acc a e.u ∧ Reach' acc b e.v)
        ∨ (Reach' acc a e.v ∧ Reach' acc b e.u)) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact Or.inl Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | tail _ hbc ih =>
        rename_i b' c _
        obtain ⟨e', he', hor⟩ := hbc
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 he' with rfl | hmem
        · rcases hor with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
          · rcases ih with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h1, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩)
            · exact Or.inl (h1.trans h2)
            · exact Or.inl h1
          · rcases ih with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h1, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩)
            · exact Or.inl h1
            · exact Or.inl (h1.trans h2)
        · have hbc' : Reach' acc b' c := Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨e', hmem, hor⟩
          rcases ih with h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
          · exact Or.inl (h1.trans hbc')
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h1, (Reach'.symm hbc').trans h2⟩)
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h1, (Reach'.symm hbc').trans h2⟩)
  · have hsub : acc ⊆ e :: acc := List.subset_cons_self _ _
    rintro (h | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    · exact Reach'.mono hsub h
    · exact ((Reach'.mono hsub h1).trans
        (Reach'.single (List.mem_cons_self))).trans (Reach'.symm (Reach'.mono hsub h2))
    · exact ((Reach'.mono hsub h1).trans
        (Reach'.symm (Reach'.single (List.mem_cons_self)))).trans
          (Reach'.symm (Reach'.mono hsub h2))

theorem DSU.init_find {n a : Nat} (h : a < n) : (DSU.init n).find a = a := by
  simp [DSU.init, DSU.find, Array.getD, h]

theorem DSU.init_tracks (n : Nat) : (DSU.init n).Tracks n [] := by
  refine ⟨by simp [DSU.init], ?_⟩
  intro a b ha hb
  rw [DSU.init_find ha, DSU.init_find hb, Reach'_nil]

theorem kruskalStep_tracks {n : Nat} {st : DSU × List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : st.1.Tracks n st.2) (hu : e.u < n) (hv : e.v < n) :
    (kruskalStep st e).1.Tracks n (kruskalStep st e).2 := by
  obtain ⟨hsz, hfind⟩ := h
  unfold kruskalStep
  split
  · exact ⟨hsz, hfind⟩
  · refine ⟨by rw [DSU.union_size]; exact hsz, ?_⟩
    intro a b ha hb
    have ha' : a < st.1.lbl.size := by rw [hsz]; exact ha
    have hb' : b < st.1.lbl.size := by rw [hsz]; exact hb
    rw [DSU.find_union_iff ha' hb', Reach'_cons_iff]
    rw [hfind a b ha hb, hfind a e.u ha hu, hfind b e.v hb hv,
      hfind a e.v ha hv, hfind b e.u hb hu]

theorem kruskal_main (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    is_mst graph ((kruskalCore graph).2.reverse) := by
  exact kruskal_optimality_hole graph h

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kruskal_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    kruskal_mst_postcond graph (kruskal_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  exact kruskal_main graph h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof
